# Quantitative Finance

## Identity
- **Abbreviation:** Quant Finance
- **Publisher:** Taylor & Francis (Routledge)
- **ISSN:** 1469-7688
- **Homepage:** https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/rquf20
- **Author guidelines:** UNVERIFIED (About page: https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/rquf20/about-this-journal)

## Scope
Per T&F: original research on quantitative methods in finance; an interdisciplinary forum for theoretical and empirical approaches; articles "should aim to be of interest to this broad readership" of researchers and practitioners. Topics (Wikipedia summary of scope) include agent-based modelling, financial econometrics, price anomalies, financial engineering, market microstructure, market dynamics and prediction.

## Scope Keywords
quantitative finance, financial econometrics, market dynamics, multiscale dependence, market microstructure, risk, interdisciplinary

## Article Types Accepted
- Research paper — other types UNVERIFIED

## Classification
- **Tier:** Q2 in Finance — SCImago SJR 2025 = 0.762; Finance Q2; best Q1 in Economics, Econometrics and Finance (misc.) (scimagojr.com source id 16062)
- **Open Access:** Hybrid; no mandatory APC; OA price UNVERIFIED
- **Field:** Quantitative finance

## Special Notes
Review speed (T&F About page): 15 days average submission to first decision (includes desk rejections); 98 days submission to first post-review decision; acceptance rate 23 %; editorial office aims for a first decision within six months. AI policy: T&F (tool, version, how and why, in Methods or Acknowledgments).

## Acceptance Signals
- **Selectivity band:** selective (23 %)
- **Desk-reject triggers:** papers not of interest to a broad quantitative readership (from aims)
